name: teamleader-secure
description: Secure Teamleader Focus access with targeted reads and explicitly confirmed updates.

interface.shortDescription: Securely consult and update Teamleader Focus.
interface.longDescription: OAuth-protected access to Teamleader Focus contacts, companies, opportunities, tasks, task calendar slots, users, draft invoices, tickets and attachments. Task updates require a clear user instruction; permanent deletion requires explicit confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Review outstanding invoices and recent tickets.
Extract the text from attachments in a Teamleader ticket.
